config.subtitle:
Introducing the new NFT created exclusively for Muse Battle winners! 🏆

The theme remains the same as the current season: a **thrilling Wild West showdown, where freedom meets fire and legends are forged.**

This young gunslinger fears no one. The only question is: **what’s more lethal — her pistols or her charm?** 🔥🤠

Available starting with the next battles, with only **15 copies ever created**.

Good luck, Muses! ⚔️
